items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Mathematician Claims Claude-Assisted Proof of Riemann Hypothesis; Lean Communities Verify
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 數學家宣稱 Claude 協助證明黎曼猜想；Lean 社群完成驗證
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge posted on his personal site that, working with Claude over roughly six weeks, he produced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis (and the generalized version) formalized in Lean as a multi-million-line library. Lean and Mathlib communities issued a joint statement of full confidence after independent checks; Anthropic has not issued an official company announcement. The human-readable write-up remains unpublished and exceeds 250,000 pages.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 數學家 Levent Alpöge 在個人網站貼文，稱與 Claude 合作約六週後，產出黎曼猜想（及廣義版本）的 Lean 形式化證明，為數百萬行程式庫。Lean 與 Mathlib 社群獨立檢查後發表聯合聲明表示完全有信心；Anthropic 尚未發布官方公司公告。人類可讀版本尚未公開，篇幅超過 25 萬頁。
items_flat.analysis_en: If the formalization holds under further expert scrutiny, it would be a landmark demonstration of AI accelerating the formalization of deep mathematical results, shifting the bottleneck from discovery to human-readable explanation and peer review. Key uncertainty remains the absence of an official Anthropic endorsement and the sheer scale of the Lean artifact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若形式化在進一步專家審查下成立，將是 AI 加速深層數學結果形式化的里程碑，瓶頸從發現轉向人類可讀解釋與同儕審查。關鍵不確定性在於缺乏 Anthropic 官方背書，以及 Lean 工件的龐大規模。
items_flat.quote: I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
items_flat.quote_zh: 我相信我與 Claude 合作發現了黎曼猜想的證明
